Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Our Electronics Tech Center in Brasov focuses on the innovation, development and testing of electronic applications in the Safety area (Active Seatbelts & Steering Wheels), coordinating end-to-end projects for OEMs.
We are now looking for a Senior Hardware Engineer to join our growing team. Our new colleague will be involved in the development of hardware products according to the Autoliv strategy and customer needs.
 What You’ll Do
 Analyze and formalize the customer requirements and standards applicable to the product
 Create and update the HW design (schematics, layouts etc.) for application or platform projects
 Identify and report the HW risks and technical difficulties (new concepts) to respect the customer requirements
 Establish and maintain the proof of design document (POD) including HSIS
 Participate to Safety & quality activities (DFMEA components, function, FTA…)
 Establish and maintain the HW tests plans for modules integration, product verification and validation
 Perform and analyze the tests and write up the test reports
 Support EMC, ESD & Electrical tests for CV, DV or PV
 Schedule all document reviews with the stakeholders involved
 Release PCB assy for manufacturing
 Define and plan the mockup realization (schematic and layout) and the miscellaneous tools (harnesses, loadbox, and so on)
 Establish and maintain all documents such as user guides (mockup) or specifications
 What You’ll Bring
 University degree in Electronics, Automation, Telecommunications or similar
 Strong electronics knowledge with automotive background
 Advanced analog and digital components knowledge
 Knowledge of measurement equipment and HW design tools knowledge (Altium Designer, MentorGraphics etc).
 Fluency in English (German or French is a plus).
